facts.fact: The journalists' union SNJT, on 11 April 2025, called on MPs to annul the 'liberticide' articles of decree-law 54 and in February 2025 adopted a motion demanding its cancellation.

SNJT president Zied Dabbar says journalists, lawyers, bloggers and citizens are being prosecuted under decree-law 54, and the report notes lawyer and columnist Sonia Dahmani is accused under its Article 24.

TUN.note: Cassation ruling of 3 February 2025 limits decree-law 54 away from audiovisual media; it is not a repeal or strike-down of an offence.
